start: GitHub, Actions tab, workflow 'Cross-role journeys (phone + admin app + server)' on main

steps.action: Press 'Run workflow' on main
user_sees: A run named 'Cross-role journeys (owner phone, api 34)' starts
must_not: The run tests an admin app or member app not built from this commit

steps.action: Wait (about an hour) while it builds the admin app, the emulator APK, frees disk and runs the journeys on an API 34 Pixel 6 emulator
user_sees: Steps 'Build the admin app', 'Build an emulator APK (x86_64)', 'Free disk space for the emulator', 'Run the cross-role journeys' turn green
must_not: The emulator download dies with 'No space left on device'
The run makes its gyms in a real customer's gym

steps.action: Open the run summary
user_sees: One line per journey: 'PASS (<n> steps)' or 'FAILED at step <n> (<who>: <what>)'
'Gyms: <A>, <B>, made fresh for this run; owner sessions signed out.'
must_not: A journey shown PASS after one of its steps failed
A failed run ending green

steps.action: Download the 'qa-journeys' artifact (kept 14 days)
user_sees: Screenshots of both apps, journeys/<J>.log, journeys/<J>-step<n>-failed.png, timeline.txt
must_not: A key-shaped string left in the evidence (the run must stop with 'KEY CHECK FAILED')

start: A run where the phone seed or one hand-off fails

steps.action: Run the workflow; the member-app seed fails or a journey step fails
user_sees: 'SEED FAILED: the phone (journeys/seed.log)' or '<J> step <n> FAILED (<who>: <what>) after <s>s'
Later steps of that journey logged as 'SKIPPED: the journey already failed at ...'
must_not: Later steps of a failed journey run on and report PASS
The run turns green

steps.action: Open the summary and the artifact
user_sees: 'journeys finished: FAILED'
The failed step's screenshot
must_not: No picture of the failed step

steps.action: Run the workflow again after a finished run
user_sees: Two new gyms with new codes, made fresh for this run
must_not: The second run reuses the first run's gyms or orders and passes on old data

steps.action: Read the summary of the second run
user_sees: Owner sessions of both runs signed out
must_not: An owner session of the earlier run still signed in

steps.action: Look at what the run left on the live server and in the artifact
user_sees: Two test gyms per run stay on the live server (the script says the gyms stay behind)
Artifact with screenshots of test gyms only
must_not: Any real gym's members, names or numbers in the screenshots or logs
A token or key printed in the public run log
